title: 1990 Donruss Baseball Milwaukee Brewers #382 Bill Spiers Rookie Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 1990 Donruss Baseball Milwaukee Brewers #382 Bill Spiers Rookie Card is a vintage trading card featuring the player Bill Spiers from the Milwaukee Brewers. Manufactured in 1989, this original card is part of the 1990 Donruss set and is made of card stock. It is a standard-sized baseball trading card in English, showcasing the player in his rookie year. This collectible item represents a piece of Major League Baseball history and is a valuable addition to any sports memorabilia collection.
